name: Miriam
description: Moses' sister living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel, and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances, answering the song: sing ye to the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously.

The prophetesses guided the women, teaching the young women to be sober and to love their husbands, and Miriam had her part in bringing Israel out of Egypt by keeping the sisters in order; that is the charge on the older sisters today toward the younger.

note.label: Exodus 15: The Song of Moses: The Lord Is a Man of War

points: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married. It was in the law not to be with the heathen. For he had married an Ethiopian woman.

Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses. What was Miriam doing? Murmuring, making herself equal to the man, putting herself in places she does not belong. A dramatization video of the chapter was played in class.

note.label: Respect: The Evidence Of Her Faith

points: Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married. This is still Zipporah, the daughter of the priest of Midian, whom Moses married in the forty years he dwelt outside Egypt, and whom the Lord allowed him to marry; a place being called Midian and the woman called an Ethiopian is no contradiction.

note.label: Numbers 12: Speaking Against the Man of God

points: So I want to show you again. We know Miriam got sprinkled with leprosy. But some of us think that God is dealing with them the same way as other men in this truth. Moses was given exclusive information, and Aaron and his sister were on the sideline trying to act like they were equal. Moses was in a secret place with the Most High God. And a lot of times we have got to see how the Lord is dealing with people, and not start to move with evil.

And the Lord spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out. And the Lord came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

The man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth. The Lord suddenly called Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to the tabernacle, came down in the pillar of the cloud, and called Aaron and Miriam forth.

note.label: Numbers 12: Speaking Against the Man of God

points: The anger of the Lord was kindled, and the cloud departed from off the tabernacle, and Miriam became leprous, white as snow. Aaron pleaded, Lay not the sin upon us; and Moses cried unto the Lord, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

note.label: Numbers 12: Speaking Against the Man of God

points: The whole congregation came into the desert of Zin in the first month and abode in Kadesh, and Miriam died there and was buried there.

note.label: Numbers 20: Strife at Meribah and Edom's Refusal

points: Jochebed the daughter of Levi bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses and Miriam their sister; and unto Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel

points: Remember what the Lord thy God did unto Miriam by the way, after that ye were come forth out of Egypt: Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married, and Miriam was not supposed to be speaking against Moses.
The anger of the Lord was kindled against them, the cloud departed from off the tabernacle, and behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow.

cases.name: Aaron and Miriam
cases.charge: Speaking against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman, and claiming an equal standing: hath he not spoken also by us?
